title: approvals: a non-admin approver's decision from the request page answers 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND — the action door loads sys_approval_request in the caller's data scope
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVy4VXmkQjn2MGeaWk

Filed by the PM seat for the W3-RT runner `session_017xRBcRX4wwwVw5bEckffdp`, whose own write was refused by its session permissions (RUNNER rule 2: staged text, posted verbatim through the same door).

QA-source: #28656 · approvals.account-app-entry · acceptance[3]

## What happens

On the request page (`/_console/apps/com.objectstack.account/sys_approval_request/record/ID`), a non-admin pending approver sees the decision panel (the #28546 fix holds: no access-denied screen). But executing any decision from that page fails. Approve → Confirm sends `POST /api/v1/actions/sys_approval_request/approval_approve` and gets **404** `{"code":"RECORD_NOT_FOUND","message":"Record areq_… not found in sys_approval_request"}`. The dialog shows that text, and the request is unchanged.

Scope: the request page's actions are all `type:'api'` through the same door. As the non-admin pending approver, `approval_reject`, `approval_comment` and `approval_request_info` each answer the same 404, so the whole decision panel is unusable. The admin, sending the same body shape to the same door, gets 200 `success:true` and the request moves. The submitter's `approval_remind` and `approval_comment` also answer 404, so Recall, Send reminder and Reply on the page do not work for non-admins either. The inbox's inline approve says "To add a comment or attachment, open the request instead", so a commented decision is impossible for a non-admin.

Measured at framework `6e11a929` (main, 2026-11-01), with the Console built in-repo, on a stock showcase boot. Reproduced on two independent boots, with two different personas and flows, and by a second independent verifier (RUNNER rule 7).

## Reproduction

1. Boot the stock showcase: `OS_PORT=PORT pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin --no-compile -p PORT -d file:/tmp/x/data.db`.
2. As admin, mint a member X: `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/invite-member` `{"email":"X","role":"member"}`, then X `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-up/email`.
3. As admin, give X two positions: `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_position` `{"user_id":X_ID,"position":"contributor","organization_id":ORG}`, and the same with `"finance"`.
4. As X: `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_invoice` `{"name":"INV-1","account":ACTIVE_ACCOUNT_ID,"owner":"X"}`, then `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_invoice/ID` `{"status":"sent","issued_on":"2026-11-01"}`. This opens request AREQ (Invoice Dual Sign-off) with X in `pending_approvers`.
5. Sign X in through the console form. Open `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.account/component/approvals/inbox`, click the row, then click Approve → Confirm.
6. **Expected:** `decision_progress` goes 0/2 → 1/2, X leaves `pending_approvers`, an `approve` row appears in `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/AREQ/actions`, and X's decision buttons are gone.
7. **Actual:** `POST /api/v1/actions/sys_approval_request/approval_approve` `{"recordId":"AREQ","params":{"comment":"…"}}` → 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND. `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/AREQ` still reads pending, 0/2, `viewer.can_act: true`.

HTTP-only form: X `POST /api/v1/actions/sys_approval_request/approval_approve` `{"recordId":"AREQ","params":{}}` → 404. The contrasts that isolate the door:
- X `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/AREQ/approve` → 200;
- the inbox inline approve (key `a`) → 200;
- admin through the action door → 200.

Second boot, second flow: the seeded non-admin persona Ada Auditor on a `showcase_dynamic_approval` stage-2 request page → Approve → Confirm → the same 404.

## Mechanism (read at 6e11a929)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` (around L428–480) sends a declared same-origin `type:'api'` action through `sendApiActionThroughDoor` (#27611) to `POST /api/v1/actions/:object/:action`.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/actions.ts` loads the subject row in the **caller's** data scope (`loadActionSubjectRecord` → `callData 'get'`, around L749). `refuseDeniedSubjectLoad` (around L882) answers 404 before the api forward (L897+) to `/api/v1/approvals/requests/{id}/approve`, which authorizes the pending approver itself.
- Members have no data-door read on `sys_approval_request`, by design: #28546's fix deliberately did not widen it. `pending-approver-read-grant.ts` grants the subject record (the invoice), not the request row.
- This is the same class as #25228 and #28546: an approvals row read through a generic data-scoped door, reached here through a third door. PR #28619's jsdom test "one approval POSTs the action door" doubled the fetch answer, so it never observed this HTTP-layer refusal.

Fix direction (a suggestion, not a ruling): route the subject load or the forward for approval actions so the approvals service authorizes the caller. Do not widen the member data grant on `sys_approval_request`.

Related, same door: the action door relays a target's 400 as "Action 'approval_approve' — its target answered HTTP 400", dropping the target's prescriptive message (seen on a dynamic-approval decision with a missing required output).

## Pin owed

No HTTP-layer or live pin covers "a non-admin approver executes a decision from the request page and the request moves". The checklist item `approvals.account-app-entry` acceptance[3] is the only coverage.

Does not reopen #28546, whose scope (the page rendering) holds.
